prompts.prompt: Use this Kyoto travel illustration as STYLE reference only. Generate ONE isolated recognizable passenger airliner, TOP DOWN view, NOSE POINTING RIGHT. Rounded ivory-white fuselage with pointed right nose, a small blue cockpit windshield at nose, two symmetric swept wings above and below, two small engines clearly below wings, coral-red tail and small tailplanes at LEFT, a few blue passenger windows, warm brown ink outline and subtle warm paper texture matching supplied picture-book map.
